article.title: Bird extinctions shift bill-flower trait matching in Hawaiian lobelioids

v12_mapping.signed_position: bill_minus_flower = bird culmen length mm - plant flower length mm

v12_mapping.baseline_and_shift: historic versus contemporary nectar-feeding bird assemblages within Hawaiian islands

next_gate: Keep the raw target closed. Reopen only on exact mirror bytes or independently available authorized Dryad access; meanwhile continue the empirical mechanism programme with another admissible system rather than weakening the signed-position construct.
claim_boundary: This source is unusually close to the v12 construct but it cannot be presented as a literature-blind prediction because the publication already reports the qualitative direction. Both anonymous automated Dryad routes are now source-access blocks, not biological confirmation or falsification. Its eventual value is independent source-native confirmation or contradiction at the signed-position-to-interaction-quality layer, not a reproductive endpoint and not proof of the full island response mechanism.
